nodes.summary: Let $G = C_2 \times C_2 \times C_2 \times C_6$. Every unit $u$ of the integral group ring $\mathbb{Z}G$ is trivial: $u = g$ or $u = -g$ for some $g \in G$.
nodes.title: No exotic units in the integral group ring of $C_2 \times C_2 \times C_2 \times C_6$

nodes.summary: Let $G = C_2 \times C_2 \times C_2 \times C_6$. The statement that the integral group ring $\mathbb{Z}G$ contains an exotic unit: a unit $u$ with $u \ne g$ and $u \ne -g$ for every $g \in G$.
nodes.title: Exotic unit conjecture for $C_2 \times C_2 \times C_2 \times C_6$

nodes.summary: The integral group ring $\mathbb{Z}G$ of $G = C_2 \times C_2 \times C_2 \times C_6$: finitely supported formal $\mathbb{Z}$-linear combinations of elements of $G$, with the product extending the group operation of $G$ bilinearly.
nodes.title: The integral group ring of $C_2 \times C_2 \times C_2 \times C_6$

nodes.summary: The abelian group $G = C_2 \times C_2 \times C_2 \times C_6$, the product of cyclic groups of orders $2$, $2$, $2$ and $6$, written additively as $\mathbb{Z}/2 \times \mathbb{Z}/2 \times \mathbb{Z}/2 \times \mathbb{Z}/6$.
nodes.title: The group $C_2 \times C_2 \times C_2 \times C_6$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
